nodes.question: How can better circularity in livestock feed systems be achieved?
nodes.answer: Better circularity in livestock feed systems can be achieved by increasing the share of grass, crop residues, and co-produces from processing in the feed, as well as by recycling and recovering nutrients and energy from animal waste through practices like composting and anaerobic digestion.
